research.title: Data Preparation and Baselines for Support Request Classification
bullets: Cleaned support request text, standardized category labels using supplied guidelines, and removed duplicate messages before preparing training and evaluation splits.
Implemented TF-IDF and logistic regression baselines in scikit-learn, reporting macro-averaged classification metrics and reviewing confusion patterns between related request categories.

work.title: Order Documentation and Dispatch Support
bullets: Checked incoming order forms for missing information, maintained filing records, and routed incomplete requests to the appropriate staff for clarification.
Updated dispatch checklists, reconciled packing slips with order records, and communicated outstanding paperwork during routine handovers between operations staff.

projects.title: Bag-of-Words Baselines for Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented count-based text representations and multinomial naive Bayes for review sentiment classification, following the prescribed preprocessing and train-test split procedure.
Compared unigram and bigram feature settings on validation data, inspected misclassified reviews, and documented errors involving negation and mixed sentiment.

projects.title: TF-IDF Baseline for Document Retrieval
bullets: Built a baseline retrieval pipeline using TF-IDF document vectors and cosine similarity to rank short articles against natural language queries.
Evaluated ranked results against supplied relevance labels, compared stopword filtering settings, and inspected failures caused by vocabulary mismatch between queries and documents.
